Herbal Remedies

 ABOUT CONSTIPATION 
 Human body is set up with a biological clock which includes all activities related to body such as digestion, excretion, sleep, daily needs and other activities. Excretion is a process of elimination of waste products from body which is vital part of daily activity of body. Excretion is important body activity so that waste products wouldn’t effect the other normal functions. Disturbance in excretion via intestines leads to problem known as Constipation. Constipation is a condition in which sewerage system of body does not work normally. Some people do not take it seriously but constipation is the cause of many other diseases. Management of constipation is necessary to keep healthy system of body. 
 It is very common gastric problem. Constipation is the inability to pass stools due to infrequent bowel movements. It makes defecation difficult and painful. Constipation is determined in large intestine which is the main area to move food, absorb water from intestine and pass stool to rectum through muscle contractions (squeezing motion). 
 According to Ayurveda there are many natural ways to prevent and manage the constipation. Herbs like amalaki , bhibhitaki , haritaki , punarnava , kalmegh etc are there. These herbs are also in the form of herbal formulations such as triphala capsules , kumaari saar by Planet Ayurveda. 
 AYURVEDA CONSTIPATION 
 As per Ayurveda, constipation is known as Vibandh. It is the inability to completely evacuate bowels or passing hard stools. It may be due to diet and lifestyle. According to Ayurveda, impaired vata dosha is responsible for digestive problems. The undigested food gets slowly accumulated in stomach and intestine that results in imbalance of vata dosha. When the digestive tract is not properly clean, then disturbance in bowel movement leads to constipation. 
 According to Ayurveda Constipation is classified into different categories: 

 Mridu Koshtha: Pitta dosha is involved. In this food is digested easily. 
 Madhyam koshta: Kapha is involved. In this food is digested ordinarily 
 Krura Koshtha: Vata doshas is involved. In this difficulty in digestion of food is seen. It is main reason of constipation. 

 CAUSES OF CONSTIPATION 
 Constipation is a common problem which may occur at any age due to many reasons. 
 Some of the common causes are given below: 

 Weak digestive system. 
 Low intake of fluids. 
 Diet containing low fibers. 
 Lack of exercise. 
 Abuse of laxatives. 
 Some medications like analgesics, anti-depressants. 
 Some diseased conditions- metabolic and endocrine disorders, neurological disorders. 
 Psychological factors like stress, anxiety, fear. 

 SYMPTOMS OF CONSTIPATION 
 Common signs and symptoms of constipation are given below: 

 Pain during passing stool 
 Bleeding during stools 
 Abdominal pain 
 Indigestion 
 Heaviness of body 
 Loss of appetite 
 Abdominal pain 
 Dry and difficult bowel movement 
 Feeling uncomfortable 

 COMPLICATIONS ASSOCIATED WITH CONSTIPATION 
 Most of the people take constipation lightly but it may get severe with time. Longer time constipation may be the reason of many severe diseases like piles, anal fissures, fecal impaction, and bowel perforation. 
 MANAGEMENT OF CONSTIPATION 
 Nowadays, Constipation is frustrating problem for everyone due to many reasons. Management of constipation is necessary with time. It can be done with the help of ayurvedic drugs, use of laxatives. Change in diet and lifestyle is also helpful in this condition. Laxatives are used to reduce constipation but it has many side effects like nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, electrolyte imbalance etc. so it is better to use natural supplements to prevent disease. 

 HOW TO TREAT CONSTIPATION IN AYURVEDA? 
 Ayurveda is an ancient Indian medicine system which helps to maintain the health issues. It is natural and holistic approach towards the health. It mainly uses natural herbs to support the disease management. Ayurveda mainly works on the principle of balance of tri energies level (vata, pitta and kapha). It follows the strategies to counter doshas and helps the bowel movement to get back into normal system. 
 CHRONIC CONSTIPATION HERBAL REMEDY IN AYURVEDA 
 Planet Ayurveda provides best combination of effective herbal remedies such as Colon Cleanse Pack for Ayurvedic Treatment of constipation . These herbal remedies are prepared from using best quality herbs and strictly follow the principles of Ayurveda. All these herbal remedies of Planet Ayurveda are 100 percent pure, natural and vegetarian. These are free from chemicals, additives and preservatives. These are safe to use as these are free from side effects.

 DIET AND LIFESTYLE 
 Constipation is mainly due to imbalanced diet and lifestyle. There are some suggestions for healthy diet and lifestyle which are given below: 


 Increased intake of fibers especially fruits and vegetables. 
 Increased intake of fluid approximately 7-8 glasses of water daily. 
 Do regular walk or exercise. 
 Eat whole grains and nuts. 
 Avoid use of spicy and high protein rich food. 
 Meat should be avoided. 

 FAQ’s on Constipation 

 1. What helps in Constipation? 
 If you have Constipation problem then you should eat more fibrous food, drink more water, eat probiotics, and take fruits such as apple, figs, pears and citrus fruits in your daily diet. Along with all these home remedies you should take Planet Ayurveda Colon Cleanse Pack which includes Triphala Capsules, Kumari Saar and Yakrit Plihantak Churna. These are made from pure natural extract of herbs and have no side effects. 


 2. What are the reasons behind Constipation? 
 Constipation is the condition of your digestive system where one can face hard feces which are difficult to expel. The main reason behind is the absorption of too much water from food in your colon. The second reason for it is a bad lifestyle and bad eating habits such as excessive fast food alcohol consumption. Certain homeopathic medications and aging are also one of the reasons for Constipation. 


 3. What are the symptoms of being constipated? 
 Having lumpy and hard stool, passing two to three stool a week, disturbed bowel movements, feeling uneasy and irritated, feeling as there is a blockage in your rectum, and you need help to empty your rectum by pressing your lower abdomen. These are some common symptoms of Constipation. 


 4. Do dairy products cause Constipation? 
 In some people, particularly children, excess intake of milk and other dairy products can cause Constipation. All the dairy products contain a low content of fiber and high content of fat which is the main reason for Constipation so you should avoid more intake of milk and dairy products. 


 5. How do you relieve Constipation pain? 
 For Constipation pain, you should increase the intake of fluids, fibers, non-fermented fibers, caffeinated coffee, and also use some herbal products such as Triphala Capsules, Kumari, and Yakrit Plihantak Churna. These herbal products are free from any side effects and having high healing power. So you must try them. 


 6. Do bananas make you constipated? 
 Unripe or green banana cause Constipation because it contains a high content of starch, which can be hard for the body to digest and it also contains fiber pectin which draws all the water from the intestine. But in ripe banana, all the starch content converted into sugar and this cannot make constipation worse. 


 7. What foods should I avoid if I am constipated? 
 Dairy products, cheese, ice-cream, excess milk, highly processed foods, red meat, chips, frozen dinner, fried products, packed food, and excess alcohol consumption etc are the foods and drinks, which make constipation worse and also may lead to abdomen pain. 


 8. Can I take fiber supplements rather than eating fiber? 
 No, you can’t, because there is a difference between fiber supplements and natural fibers. Some people feel that the supplements make them more uncomfortable during constipation problem so instead of taking any supplements you should try Planet Ayurveda Colon Cleanse Pack which contains pure natural herbal extracts in it and you can get relief from constipation within few days. 


 9. Which vitamins help to provide relief from Constipation? 
 Vitamin C, Vitamin B-5, Folic acid, and Vitamin B-9, Vitamin B-12 are good for constipation problem. Vitamin C is water soluble vitamin and it can pull water into your intestine and make stool soften. Vitamin B-5 helps in muscles contraction in your digestive system which moves your stool easily towards your intestine. Folic acid and Vitamin B-9 increase the digestion power by the formation of digestive acids which will speed up digestion process. You should also take vitamin B-12 because it also eases the Constipation problem. 


 10. How can I get Vitamin B-12 naturally? 
 The main sources of Vitamin B-12 are beef, liver, chicken, fish such as salmon, tuna fish, eggs, fortified breakfast cereals, low-fat milk, and yogurt. All these products are rich in Vitamin B-12. So you should add these products to your diet if you have vitamin B-12 deficiency. 


 11. Are laxative foods good for Constipation? 
 Yes, laxative foods such as dried plums, chia seeds, figs, leafy green vegetables, pears, kiwi, spinach, and apple are good for Constipation because plum contains cellulose which increases the amount of water in the stool. Others foods also stimulate the bowel movement during Constipation so you should add theses laxatives into your daily diet. 


 12. Is Apple Cider Vinegar good for Constipation? 
 Yes, Apple Cider Vinegar is natural laxative and it contains pectin which is a water-soluble fiber and also have malic acid and acidic acid which improves the overall digestion of your body. Magnesium in ACV promotes the regular bowel movement. 


 13. Can Constipation go away by itself? 
 Most of the time it goes away by itself by taking some laxatives and other foods which are helpful in constipation, but if you have this problem longer than one or two weeks than you should go for some herbal products which are purely natural and free from any additives and preservatives. You can opt for Planet Ayurveda Colon Cleanse Pack, you definitely feel better after using it.
